messages.author: Lewis 'Newt' Hunter
messages.content:
Y'all. It happened.
Newt's Nook is online! It is time for some serious shenanigans.

messages.author: Lewis 'Newt' Hunter
messages.content:
I just helped Ash with a very... interesting project request.
Makes sense though. I support Ash being her genuine self.

messages.author: Lewis 'Newt' Hunter
messages.content:
Today wasn't much to talk about. I spent the entire day preparing to play a game that I never got to.
Let's just say I had some technical difficulties.

messages.author: Ashley Hunter
messages.content: That should go on a shirt! A label that says "Currently experiencing technical difficulties"!!

messages.author: Lewis 'Newt' Hunter
messages.content: The Internet was out for so long... Y'all.. I thought I was gonna die.

messages.author: Lewis 'Newt' Hunter
messages.content: I wonder why waiting feels like a task I gotta complete by doing absolutely nothing between now and then...
